Can you fill in these Xs for me? Whitaker is one of XX players on the Modern Era committee vote,
And do we have a story ready to fire on Whitaker for tomorrow? Should probably pre-write a “he’s in” story … and a “he’s not in”
Neither of them have to be terribly long. But let’s get them in Presto tonight or early tomorrow if possible.
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
